verdict: Lead volume collapsed this week; the cause is identified and being addressed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 86 leads at an average cost of $8.14 per lead, but the last seven days tell a sharper story: lead volume dropped 66.67% week-over-week while spend held nearly flat, pushing cost per lead up 179% in that window. The last four days produced zero leads on continued daily spend, which points to ad creative fatigue — the same budget is running but the ads have stopped converting. We are refreshing the ad creative this week to reset delivery efficiency. Separately, 85 opportunities entered your pipeline this period and none have been marked won and no appointments are logged, so we are also reviewing the intake and follow-up process to make sure leads that do arrive are being captured and contacted.
